_comment: Config for scripts/gen-llms.py. Committed as config rather than hardcoded so a
coverage decision is reviewable in a diff instead of buried in a script.
exclude:  sitemap URLs deliberately kept OUT of llms.txt. /join and /audits are
already absent from the sitemap (robots.txt disallows both), so they
are listed here to record the intent, not because they would leak.
sections: URL prefix -> llms.txt section heading. Longest prefix wins.
descriptions: verbatim copy that OVERRIDES a page's meta description. Use only
for lines supplied by Strategy. Everything else takes the page's own
approved meta description so no description is authored by Code.

descriptions./case-studies/wally-puerto-rico: Puerto Rico luxury property — 2.5× revenue in 12 months under Marketics revenue management.
descriptions./case-studies/montreal-hotel: Montréal boutique hotel — occupancy from 43% to 80%, foreclosure turnaround.
descriptions./case-studies/anthony-san-antonio: San Antonio portfolio — 15 listings, $12K to $41K per month.
descriptions./case-studies: Documented client results: occupancy turnarounds, portfolio scaling, and revenue multiples — methodology at /intel/str-performance-index.
